args.title: Summary: Bellwether newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Bellwether Office newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026") links to the main article at blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain and a reader/org-tailored companion piece at insights.bellwether.example.
- Article: temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
